tool_args.rationale: The five pilot rows vary u_now and s_grad together, leaving genuine identifiability ambiguity among the candidate response families. Acquire the available open-branch discriminating probe; the source note's high-sgrad probe is not listed in the available cost menu.

The outputs are non-monotone across the sampled u_now values, and s_grad effects are not identified.
More expensive than the open-branch probe and unnecessary before resolving the competing response mechanisms.
